title: Damage and Missing-Item Report Terms - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, damage and missing items are reported within a set number of calendar days after the order's completion, and a refund for a damaged or missing item is given without the item coming back only up to a set amount. The terms differ by fulfillment method.

| Fulfillment method | Damage reported within (calendar days after completion) | Missing item reported within (calendar days after completion) | Damaged, missing or wrong item may be replaced instead of refunded | Largest line refund given without the item coming back |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | 14 | 30 | Yes | $25.00 |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | 14 | 30 | Yes | $25.00 |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 2 | 2 | Yes | $25.00 |
| Curbside Pickup | 2 | 2 | Yes | $25.00 |
| Same-Day Delivery | 2 | 2 | No | $25.00 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 2 | 7 | Yes | $0.00 |

**What the columns mean**

1. The damage and missing-item periods are counted in calendar days after the order's completion.
2. "Replaced instead of refunded" states whether a free replacement may be sent for a damaged, missing or wrong item in place of a refund.
3. The last column is the largest refund, in USD, given for a damaged or missing item without requiring the item back.

**Points of reading**

- The ship-to-home methods allow 14 days for damage and 30 for a missing item; the store-fulfilled methods allow 2 days for each.
- Large Item Freight Delivery allows 2 days for damage and 7 for a missing item, and its returnless limit is $0.00.
- Same-Day Delivery is the only method on which a replacement is not available.
